name: Phichol
overview: Phichol is identified in Scripture as the chief captain of the Philistine forces, prominently appearing alongside Abimelech in key interactions with the patriarch Abraham and later Isaac. The passages in Genesis 21 and 26 depict Phichol as a leading military figure who participates in diplomatic engagements, including the making of a covenant at Beersheba. His role underscores the presence of organized Philistine leadership during the patriarchal period and highlights the intersection of God's providence with the political realities surrounding God's people.
